branchId.description: If the entry is an aggregate branch (i.e. a tag), this is the branch ID

controlReportingUnitId.description: The reporting unit ID of the control site

controlForReportingUnitId.description: The reporting unit ID of the site this is a control for

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the reporting unit. Acts as a key way to organize and aggregate reporting units.

items.description: A tag associated with the reporting unit, must be URL-safe.

label.description: The label / name of the reporting unit.

description.description: A description of the reporting unit.

updatedAt.description: When the entry was last updated (ISO8601)

analysisSubmittedAt.description: When the entry was submitted for processing (ISO8601)

analysisCompletedAt.description: When the entry analysis was lasy updated (ISO8601)

qualityControlledAt.description: When the entry was QC approved, without this the analysis is considered preliminary and should not be used (ISO8601)

refundedAt.description: When the entry's usage was refunded (ISO8601)

usersNotifiedAt.description: When the users were notified the site is ready, only happens once (ISO8601)

webhookNotifiedAt.description: When the registered webhook was notified successfully last. Can be used to recover from dropped webhook events. (ISO8601)

periodChangeStartYear.description: The start of the period of interest

periodChangeEndYear.description: The end of the period of interest (inclusive)

boundaryPath.description: The path to the geojson boundary for this site

hidden.description: Whether the entry is hidden by default in the frontend and excluded from aggregation stats. Useful for control sites.

areaKm2.description: The vector area of the reporting unit in square kilometers.

analyzedAreaKm2.description: The raster area of the reporting unit in square kilometers to be used when computing densities.

pointX.description: The representative circle X (long) coord, guaranteed to intersect the boundary

pointY.description: The representative circle Y (lat) coord, guaranteed to intersect the boundary

pointR.description: The representative circle R coord, such that the circle fully contains the boundary

srcOrganizationId.description: The organization ID of the source organization for this reporting unit, used only if it was copied between environments / organizations.

dataPath.description: The path to the data files for this reporting unit, used only if it was copied between environments / organizations.

periodChangeStartYearStock.description: The stock value for the start of the period of interest

periodChangeStartYearStockError.description: The stock error for the start of the period of interest

periodChangeEndYearStock.description: The stock value for the end of the period of interest

periodChangeEndYearStockError.description: The stock error for the end of the period of interest

periodChange.description: The change in stock over the period of interest

periodChangeError.description: The error in the change in stock over the period of interest

periodChangePercent.description: The percent change in stock over the period of interest compared to the start.

periodChangeGain.description: The gain in stock over the period of interest

periodChangeGainError.description: The error in the gain in stock over the period of interest

periodChangeLoss.description: The loss in stock over the period of interest

periodChangeLossError.description: The error in the loss in stock over the period of interest

dryrun.description: Whether the entry was created as a dryrun, prevents it from being processed and marks it as deletedAt 3 hours in the future.

createdAsDryrun.description: Present (true) on entries created with dryrun=true, and kept after such an entry is restored or approved and becomes a regular entry. Absent on entries created without dryrun. Whether an entry is a dryrun now is given by analysisStatus and expiresAt.

calibratedTo.description: The reporting unit ID of the site this is calibrated to.

calibratedFrom.description: The reporting unit ID of the site this is calibrated from.

mangrove.description: Whether or not the reporting unit is a mangrove site.
